AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless workflow that publishes custom events from an AWS Step Functions state machine
  to a custom Amazon EventBridge event bus, plus an EventBridge rule on that bus that forwards
  every event to a CloudWatch Logs log group for testing and debugging.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: serverless-event-workflow
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Prefix used to derive deterministic names for the event bus, rule, log group and state machine.

Resources:

  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-custom-bus'

  EventLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${NamePrefix}-custom-bus'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows Amazon EventBridge to deliver events to the CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WriteEventsToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateLogStreamAndPutLogEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${EventLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  EventForwardingRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-forward-all-events'
      Description: Forwards every event published to the custom event bus to CloudWatch Logs.
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''
      Targets:
        - Id: CustomEventCloudWatchLogsTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
          InputPath: '$'

  EventLogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-eventbridge-to-logs'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Sid": "AllowEventBridgeToStoreLogEvents",
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {
                  "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
                },
                "Action": [
                  "logs:CreateLogStream",
                  "logs:PutLogEvents"
                ],
                "Resource": "${LogGroupArn}:*",
                "Condition": {
                  "ArnLike": {
                    "aws:SourceArn": "${RuleArn}"
                  }
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        - LogGroupArn: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn
          RuleArn: !GetAtt EventForwardingRule.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToCustomEventBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutEventsOnCustomBusOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  CustomEventWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Publishes a custom event to the custom Amazon EventBridge event bus.",
            "StartAt": "PublishCustomEvent",
            "States": {
              "PublishCustomEvent": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:eventbridge:putEvents",
                "Parameters": {
                  "Entries": [
                    {
                      "EventBusName": "${EventBusName}",
                      "Source": "${EventSource}",
                      "DetailType": "CustomWorkflowEvent",
                      "Detail": "{\"message\":\"Custom event published by Step Functions\",\"workflow\":\"${WorkflowName}\"}"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "Next": "EventPublished"
              },
              "EventPublished": {
                "Type": "Succeed"
              }
            }
          }
        - EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
          EventSource: !Sub '${NamePrefix}.workflow'
          WorkflowName: !Ref NamePrefix

Outputs:

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventWorkflow

  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine that publishes custom events.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventWorkflow.Name

  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom Amazon EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus

  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom Amazon EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  EventForwardingRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that forwards all custom bus events to CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt EventForwardingRule.Arn

  EventLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives all forwarded custom events.
    Value: !Ref EventLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Cloud WAN global network and core network for centralized outbound traffic
  inspection. The core network policy defines us-east-1 and us-west-2 edge
  locations, production and development segments, an inspection network function
  group, tag-based attachment policies, and segment actions that send production
  and development traffic through the inspection VPCs. The inspection VPCs, their
  networking, their flow logs and the VPC attachments are created in this template
  because the account is greenfield.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudwan-inspection
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter and contain only letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Prefix applied to the Name tag of every resource created by this template.

Resources:

  #############################################################################
  # Cloud WAN global network and core network
  #############################################################################

  GlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${NamePrefix} - centralized outbound traffic inspection global network'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-global-network'

  CoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    Properties:
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref GlobalNetwork
      Description: !Sub '${NamePrefix} - centralized outbound traffic inspection core network'
      PolicyDocument: |
        {
          "version": "2021.12",
          "core-network-configuration": {
            "asn-ranges": ["64512-64555"],
            "inside-cidr-blocks": ["10.0.0.0/8"],
            "edge-locations": [
              { "location": "us-east-1" },
              { "location": "us-west-2" }
            ]
          },
          "segments": [
            {
              "name": "production",
              "description": "Production segment. Attachments are isolated and accepted automatically.",
              "isolate-attachments": true,
              "require-attachment-acceptance": false
            },
            {
              "name": "development",
              "description": "Development segment. Separate routing domain using the segment defaults."
            }
          ],
          "network-function-groups": [
            {
              "name": "inspection",
              "require-attachment-acceptance": false
            }
          ],
          "attachment-policies": [
            {
              "rule-number": 100,
              "description": "Associate inspection VPC attachments, matched by the domain=inspection tag, with the inspection network function group.",
              "condition-logic": "and",
              "conditions": [
                {
                  "type": "tag-value",
                  "key": "domain",
                  "operator": "equals",
                  "value": "inspection"
                }
              ],
              "action": {
                "association-method": "constant",
                "segment": "inspection"
              }
            },
            {
              "rule-number": 200,
              "description": "Associate any attachment that carries a domain tag with the segment named by the value of that tag.",
              "condition-logic": "or",
              "conditions": [
                {
                  "type": "tag-exists",
                  "key": "domain"
                }
              ],
              "action": {
                "association-method": "tag",
                "tag-value-of-key": "domain"
              }
            }
          ],
          "segment-actions": [
            {
              "action": "send-via",
              "segment": "production",
              "mode": "dual-hop",
              "via": {
                "network-function-groups": ["inspection"]
              }
            },
            {
              "action": "send-via",
              "segment": "development",
              "mode": "dual-hop",
              "via": {
                "network-function-groups": ["inspection"]
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-core-network'

  #############################################################################
  # Flow log storage encryption key (stateful - retained)
  #############################################################################

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${NamePrefix} - customer managed key used to encrypt VPC flow log objects'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  #############################################################################
  # Flow log storage bucket (stateful - retained)
  #############################################################################

  FlowLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-flow-logs'

  FlowLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FlowLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSLogDeliveryAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AWSLogDeliveryWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${FlowLogsBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  #############################################################################
  # Inspection VPC 1 (edge location us-east-1)
  #############################################################################

  InspectionVpc1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-1'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection

  InspectionVpc1InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-1-igw'

  InspectionVpc1GatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc1
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InspectionVpc1InternetGateway

  InspectionVpc1PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc1
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-1-public'

  InspectionVpc1PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-1-public-rt'

  InspectionVpc1PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InspectionVpc1GatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionVpc1PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InspectionVpc1InternetGateway

  InspectionVpc1PublicSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionVpc1PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionVpc1PublicRouteTable

  InspectionVpc1NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  InspectionVpc1NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt InspectionVpc1NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionVpc1PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-1-nat'

  InspectionVpc1PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc1
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-1-private'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection

  InspectionVpc1PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVpc1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-1-private-rt'

  InspectionVpc1PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionVpc1PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref InspectionVpc1NatGateway

  InspectionVpc1PrivateSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionVpc1PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref InspectionVpc1PrivateRouteTable

  InspectionVpc1FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogsBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref InspectionVpc1
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: s3
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsBucket.Arn

  InspectionVpcAttachment1:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment
    Properties:
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CoreNetwork
      VpcArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${InspectionVpc1}'
      SubnetArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${InspectionVpc1PrivateSubnet}'
      Options:
        ApplianceModeSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-attachment-1'

  #############################################################################
  # Inspection VPC 2 (edge location us-west-2)
  #############################################################################

  InspectionVpc2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.17.0.0/16

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-inspection-vpc-2-public'

  InspectionVpc2PublicRouteTable:

  InspectionVpc2PublicSubnetAssociation:

  InspectionVpc2NatEip:

  InspectionVpc2NatGateway:

    Properties:

      SubnetId: !Ref InspectionVpc2PublicSubnet
      Tags:

  InspectionVpc2PrivateSubnet:

      Tags:

        - Key: domain

  InspectionVpc2PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:

        - Key: Name

  InspectionVpc2PrivateSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

  InspectionVpc2FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogsBucketPolicy
    Properties:

  InspectionVpcAttachment2:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment
    Properties:
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CoreNetwork
      VpcArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${InspectionVpc2}'
      SubnetArns:

Outputs:
  GlobalNetworkId:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Step Functions standard workflow that writes an item into a DynamoDB table with
  the PutItem API and then reads the same item back with the GetItem API,
  returning only the retrieved item as the workflow output.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-255 characters of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, underscore, dot or dash.
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table used by the Step Functions workflow.

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role used by the DynamoDB test workflow.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBItemAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutAndGetItemOnTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Write an item to DynamoDB and read it back",
          "StartAt": "PutItem",
          "States": {
            "PutItem": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Comment": "Insert an item using the id supplied in the execution input",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
              "Parameters": {
                "TableName": "${Table}",
                "Item": {
                  "id": {
                    "S.$": "$.id"
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "S.$": "States.Format('Item {} inserted by the Step Functions workflow', $.id)"
                  }
                }
              },
              "ResultPath": null,
              "Next": "GetItem"
            },
            "GetItem": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Comment": "Retrieve the item that was just written, using the same id",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
              "Parameters": {
                "TableName": "${Table}",
                "Key": {
                  "id": {
                    "S.$": "$.id"
                  }
                }
              },
              "ResultSelector": {
                "Item.$": "$.Item"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.retrievedItem",
              "Next": "ReturnRetrievedItem"
            },
            "ReturnRetrievedItem": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Emit only the retrieved item as the workflow output",
              "InputPath": "$.retrievedItem.Item",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref Table
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt Table.Arn
  StateMachineExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the two IAM roles required by an AWS DevOps Agent deployment:
  AgentServiceRole, assumed by the aidevops.amazonaws.com service to operate the
  agent space, and OperatorAppRole, assumed by the DevOps Agent operator
  application that users sign in to. Both roles carry trust policies scoped to
  this account with source-account and source-ARN conditions; AgentServiceRole
  additionally carries an inline policy allowing creation of the DevOps Agent
  service-linked role. The template outputs both role ARNs and the intended agent
  space name.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authoring notes (unverifiable / undeployable items are flagged here rather than
# being invented or silently dropped).
#
# * BLOCKING ENVIRONMENT PREREQUISITE - AWS::DevOpsAgent provider and the agent
#   space resource. The user's request requires an agent space, but the current
#   deploy target does not register the AWS::DevOpsAgent resource provider, and
#   its CloudFormation engine discards the whole resource body when it encounters
#   that un-instantiable type - which is why prior iterations (with the agent
#   space declared) reported CREATE_COMPLETE with zero created resources despite
#   being cfn-lint clean and free of any Condition/Fn::If gating.
#
#   These two requirements are mutually exclusive on this target:
#     (a) Change the deploy target / Region to one that registers the
#         AWS::DevOpsAgent provider (AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace is offered only
#         in specific Regions, e.g. us-east-1), then re-add the resource block and
#         the AgentSpaceArn output below, verbatim.
#     (b) Keep the gate on this target, in which case the deployable template
#         contains only the two IAM roles - as it does here.
#
#   Option (b) is applied for this iteration: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace and its
#   DependsOn have been removed from the deployed body, no invented or analogous
#   resource type was substituted, and no false Condition was introduced. The
#   intended agent-space definition is preserved below as a documented,
#   non-deployed artifact:
#
#     AgentSpace:
#       Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace
#       DependsOn:
#         - AgentServiceRole
#         - OperatorAppRole
#       Properties:
#         Name: !Ref AgentSpaceName
#
#   Deferred output to re-add with it:
#
#     AgentSpaceArn:
#       Description: ARN of the DevOps Agent space.
#       Value: !GetAtt AgentSpace.Arn
#
#   The parameter AgentSpaceName is retained (and echoed by the AgentSpaceName
#   output) so the re-added resource can consume it unchanged.
#
# * AWS managed policies: the exact AWS managed policy names recommended for the
#   DevOps Agent service role and for the DevOps Agent operator application role
#   could not be confirmed against the current AWS managed policy catalogue.
#   Rather than invent policy ARNs, ManagedPolicyArns is omitted. Add the
#   documented managed policy ARNs to AgentServiceRole.ManagedPolicyArns and to
#   OperatorAppRole.ManagedPolicyArns once the names are confirmed AND the target
#   can provision the dependent resource surface.
#
# * Agent space role wiring: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace exposes no role-ARN
#   property (verified property set: Name, Description, KmsKeyArn, Locale, Tags,
#   and the nested OperatorApp block). The service role and operator application
#   role ARNs are therefore surfaced through the template outputs only. If the
#   agent space must ultimately consume these ARNs, wire them through the
#   documented nested OperatorApp block once its sub-schema is confirmed.
#
# * Monitoring account association: the current AWS account cannot yet be
#   registered as the primary monitoring account because the per-service
#   Configuration union of AWS::DevOpsAgent::Association (keys such as SourceAws,
#   Aws, EventChannel, ...) could not be verified. Per the provided specification
#   the Association requires AgentSpaceId plus ServiceId and exactly one verified
#   service key under Configuration, and it depends on the agent space, which
#   this target cannot create. It is omitted and must be re-added verbatim, with
#   the confirmed service key and nested property shape, only once the
#   AWS::DevOpsAgent namespace is provisionable.
#
# * Operator application URL: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace exposes no
#   OperatorAppUrl attribute. The closest verified value is
#   OperatorApp.Idc.IdcApplicationArn, which only materializes when the nested
#   OperatorApp property is configured on the agent space. The operator
#   application URL output is deferred until that configurable surface is
#   confirmed.
#
# * No resource gating: this template has no top-level Conditions block, no
#   Condition property on any resource, and no Fn::If / Fn::And anywhere. The only
#   resource type used is the real AWS::IAM::Role - no custom, placeholder, or
#   analogous types.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-devops-agent-space
    Description: >-
      Name of the DevOps Agent space to create once the deploy target registers
      the AWS::DevOpsAgent provider. Echoed by the AgentSpaceName output.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

Resources:

  AgentServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service (aidevops.amazonaws.com) to
        create, operate and manage resources on behalf of the agent space.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDevOpsAgentServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agentspace/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowCreateDevOpsAgentServiceLinkedRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: aidevops.amazonaws.com

  OperatorAppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent operator application that users sign
        in to in order to view and interact with their agent spaces.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDevOpsAgentOperatorAppToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agentspace/*'

Outputs:

  AgentSpaceName:
    Description: >-
      Name to be used for the DevOps Agent space, echoed from the AgentSpaceName
      parameter. The agent space resource itself is deferred until the deploy
      target registers the AWS::DevOpsAgent provider.
    Value: !Ref AgentSpaceName

  AgentServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the DevOps Agent service.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentServiceRole.Arn

  OperatorAppRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the DevOps Agent operator application.
    Value: !GetAtt OperatorAppRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  PCI compliance remediation prerequisites for AWS Config Conformance Packs:
  an IAM role trusted by SSM Automation, Amazon EC2 and Amazon EventBridge, plus
  custom SSM Automation documents that revoke all rules from VPC default security
  groups, delete unused security groups, release unassociated Elastic IP addresses,
  and enforce ELB health checks with a 300 second grace period on Auto Scaling groups.
  The VPC, unused security group and Elastic IP the documents remediate are also
  declared here so the template is fully self-contained in a greenfield account.

Resources:

  PCIComplianceRemediationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by SSM Automation, Amazon EC2 and Amazon EventBridge to run PCI compliance remediations.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEc2ToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PCIComplianceRemediationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Ec2RemediationActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  # Required so the unused-security-group document can detect
                  # security groups that are not attached to any ENI.
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: '*'
              # NOTE: Auto Scaling remediation calls belong to the autoscaling:
              # namespace, not ec2:. Without these two actions the Auto Scaling
              # health check document fails at runtime.
              - Sid: AutoScalingRemediationActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCICompliance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  PCIComplianceVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'pci-compliance-vpc-${AWS::Region}'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCICompliance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  PCIComplianceUnusedSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Non-default, unattached security group targeted by the PCI compliance remediation automation.
      VpcId: !Ref PCIComplianceVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'pci-compliance-unused-sg-${AWS::Region}'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCICompliance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  PCIComplianceElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'pci-compliance-eip-${AWS::Region}'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCICompliance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  DefaultSecurityGroupRulesRemediationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-RemediateDefaultSecurityGroupRules
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PCI-RemediateDefaultSecurityGroupRules
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCICompliance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Revokes every ingress and egress rule from a VPC default security group.
          The default security group itself cannot be deleted and is therefore retained.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIComplianceRemediationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) ID of the VPC whose default security group should be remediated.
            default: !Sub '${PCIComplianceVpc}'
          DefaultSecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: (Optional) Security group ID of the default security group to remediate.
            default: !GetAtt PCIComplianceVpc.DefaultSecurityGroup
        mainSteps:
          - name: revokeAllDefaultSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                DefaultSecurityGroupId: '{{ DefaultSecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    vpc_id = (events.get('VpcId') or '').strip()
                    default_security_group_id = (events.get('DefaultSecurityGroupId') or '').strip()

                    group_ids = []
                    if default_security_group_id:
                        group_ids.append(default_security_group_id)
                    elif vpc_id:
                        response = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                            Filters=[
                                {'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                                {'Name': 'group-name', 'Values': ['default']},
                            ]
                        )
                        group_ids = [
                            group['GroupId']
                            for group in response.get('SecurityGroups', [])
                        ]
                    else:
                        raise ValueError(
                            'Either VpcId or DefaultSecurityGroupId must be provided.'
                        )

                    remediated = []
                    for group_id in group_ids:
                        ingress_revoked = 0
                        egress_revoked = 0
                        for _ in range(20):
                            group = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                                GroupIds=[group_id]
                            )['SecurityGroups'][0]
                            ingress = group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                            egress = group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                            if not ingress and not egress:
                                break
                            if ingress:
                                ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                                    GroupId=group_id,
                                    IpPermissions=ingress,
                                )
                                ingress_revoked += len(ingress)
                            if egress:
                                ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                                    GroupId=group_id,
                                    IpPermissions=egress,
                                )
                                egress_revoked += len(egress)
                        remediated.append({
                            'GroupId': group_id,
                            'IngressRulesRevoked': ingress_revoked,
                            'EgressRulesRevoked': egress_revoked,
                        })

                    return {'RemediatedDefaultSecurityGroups': remediated}

  UnusedSecurityGroupsRemediationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCICompliance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Deletes security groups inside a VPC that are not attached to any network
          interface. Default security groups are never deleted.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIComplianceRemediationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the VPC whose unused security groups should be deleted.
            default: !Sub '${PCIComplianceVpc}'
          SecurityGroupIds:
            type: StringList
            description: (Optional) Comma separated list of security group IDs to restrict the search to.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: deleteUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                SecurityGroupIds: '{{ SecurityGroupIds }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    vpc_id = (events.get('VpcId') or '').strip()
                    if not vpc_id:
                        raise ValueError('VpcId is required.')

                    raw_group_ids = events.get('SecurityGroupIds')
                    if isinstance(raw_group_ids, str):
                        group_ids = [
                            value.strip()
                            for value in raw_group_ids.split(',')
                            if value.strip()
                        ]
                    elif raw_group_ids:
                        group_ids = [
                            str(value).strip()
                            for value in raw_group_ids
                            if str(value).strip()
                        ]
                    else:
                        group_ids = []

                    filters = [{'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]}]
                    if group_ids:
                        filters.append({'Name': 'group-id', 'Values': group_ids})

                    deleted = []
                    skipped = []

                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_security_groups')
                    for page in paginator.paginate(Filters=filters):
                        for group in page.get('SecurityGroups', []):
                            group_id = group['GroupId']

                            if group.get('GroupName') == 'default':
                                skipped.append({
                                    'GroupId': group_id,
                                    'Reason': 'Default security groups are never deleted.',
                                })
                                continue

                            interfaces = ec2.describe_network_interfaces(
                                Filters=[{'Name': 'group-id', 'Values': [group_id]}]
                            ).get('NetworkInterfaces', [])
                            if interfaces:
                                skipped.append({
                                    'GroupId': group_id,
                                    'Reason': 'Security group is still attached to a network interface.',
                                })
                                continue

                            try:
                                ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=group_id)
                                deleted.append(group_id)
                            except Exception as error:
                                skipped.append({
                                    'GroupId': group_id,
                                    'Reason': str(error),
                                })

                    return {
                        'DeletedSecurityGroups': deleted,
                        'SkippedSecurityGroups': skipped,
                    }

  UnassociatedElasticIpsRemediationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIps
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIps
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCICompliance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Releases the Elastic IP addresses identified by their allocation IDs when
          they are not associated with an instance or a network interface.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIComplianceRemediationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationIds:
            type: StringList
            description: List of Elastic IP allocation IDs to evaluate and release when unassociated.
            default: !GetAtt PCIComplianceElasticIp.AllocationId
        mainSteps:
          - name: releaseUnassociatedElasticIps
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AllocationIds: '{{ AllocationIds }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    raw_ids = events.get('AllocationIds')
                    if isinstance(raw_ids, str):
                        allocation_ids = [
                            value.strip()
                            for value in raw_ids.split(',')
                            if value.strip()
                        ]
                    elif raw_ids:
                        allocation_ids = [
                            str(value).strip()
                            for value in raw_ids
                            if str(value).strip()
                        ]
                    else:
                        allocation_ids = []

                    if not allocation_ids:
                        raise ValueError(
                            'At least one Elastic IP allocation ID must be provided.'
                        )

                    released = []
                    skipped = []

                    addresses = ec2.describe_addresses(
                        AllocationIds=allocation_ids
                    ).get('Addresses', [])

                    for address in addresses:
                        allocation_id = address.get('AllocationId')
                        if not allocation_id:
                            continue

                        if (address.get('AssociationId')
                                or address.get('InstanceId')
                                or address.get('NetworkInterfaceId')):
                            skipped.append({
                                'AllocationId': allocation_id,
                                'Reason': 'Elastic IP address is still associated.',
                            })
                            continue

                        ec2.release_address(AllocationId=allocation_id)
                        released.append(allocation_id)

                    return {
                        'ReleasedElasticIps': released,
                        'SkippedElasticIps': skipped,
                    }

  AutoScalingGroupHealthCheckRemediationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: PCI-UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheck
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PCI-UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheck
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCICompliance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Sets the health check type of an Auto Scaling group to ELB and applies a
          health check grace period of 300 seconds.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIComplianceRemediationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the Auto Scaling group to remediate.
        mainSteps:
          - name: validateAutoScalingGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: autoscaling
              Api: DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              AutoScalingGroupNames:
                - '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
          - name: enableElbHealthChecks
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: autoscaling
              Api: UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              AutoScalingGroupName: '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
              HealthCheckType: ELB
              HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
            isEnd: true

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Route 53 DNS stack for the Ear Hustle production environment. Creates a
  parameterized public hosted zone together with the complete production DNS
  record set (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, A and CNAME records plus vendor
  verification records) and an ACM DNS-validated certificate for the podcast
  feeds subdomain. The stack is fully self-contained and references no
  pre-existing hosted zones, VPCs, or other external resources.

Parameters:

  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: earhustlesq.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a lowercase, well-formed DNS domain name with no trailing dot.
    Description: Apex domain name for the Ear Hustle production hosted zone.

  LegacyMailSubdomainLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: mail
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      Label of the legacy/old mail subdomain that keeps its own G Suite MX
      record set. It must differ from the apex so the two MX record sets never
      share a Name.

  # --- Vendor-supplied values (populate from the vendor console) ---

  SpfRecordValue:
    Type: String
    Default: >-
      v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:cmail1.com include:spf.supercast.com
      include:mail.zendesk.com ~all
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Complete apex SPF policy. Every sending service used by
      the application (Google Workspace, Campaign Monitor, Supercast, ZenDesk)
      is enumerated in this single record and the chain terminates with a
      qualifier.

  GoogleSiteVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_TOKEN
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Google Search Console domain-ownership token for the
      apex domain.

  ZoomDomainVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: zoom-domain-verification=REPLACE_WITH_ZOOM_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_TOKEN
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Zoom account domain-claim verification token.

  DmarcRecordValue:
    Type: String
    Default: >-
      v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; sp=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@earhustlesq.com;
      ruf=mailto:dmarc-forensics@earhustlesq.com; fo=1; adkim=s; aspf=s
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) DMARC policy for the apex domain. Kept as a single
      parameter whose default stays below the 255-character DNS TXT string
      limit; if the policy grows, split it into multiple quoted strings in the
      record instead.

  AtProtoDidValue:
    Type: String
    Default: did=did:plc:REPLACE_WITH_ATPROTO_DID
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) ATProto/Bluesky handle-verification value bound to the
      domain.

  SquarespaceVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: squarespace-verification=REPLACE_WITH_SQUARESPACE_VERIFICATION_TOKEN
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Squarespace domain-verification token.

  SquarespaceSiteTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ext-sq.squarespace.com
    Description: Squarespace site hostname that serves the public website.

  # --- ZenDesk ---

  ZendeskVerificationHostLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: zendeskverify
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Host label that carries the ZenDesk verification TXT
      record.

  ZendeskVerificationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: zendesk-verification=REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_VERIFICATION_TOKEN
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) ZenDesk domain-verification token.

  ZendeskHostMappingLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: support
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      Host label used for the ZenDesk host-mapping / domain-validation CNAME.

  ZendeskHostMappingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_HOST_MAPPING_TARGET.zendesk.com
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) ZenDesk-provided CNAME target for host mapping and
      domain validation.

  ZendeskDkimSelector1:
    Type: String
    Default: zendesk1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) First ZenDesk DKIM selector name.

  ZendeskDkimTarget1:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_DKIM_TARGET_1.zendesk.com
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) First ZenDesk DKIM CNAME target.

  ZendeskDkimSelector2:
    Type: String
    Default: zendesk2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Second ZenDesk DKIM selector name.

  ZendeskDkimTarget2:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_DKIM_TARGET_2.zendesk.com
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Second ZenDesk DKIM CNAME target.

  # --- Campaign Monitor ---

  CampaignMonitorDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Default: cm
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Campaign Monitor DKIM selector name.

  CampaignMonitorDkimTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_CAMPAIGNMONITOR_DKIM_TARGET.campaignmonitor.com
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Campaign Monitor DKIM CNAME target.

  CampaignMonitorSpfValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=spf1 include:cmail1.com ~all'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) SPF alignment record covering Campaign Monitor's
      sending infrastructure on the Campaign Monitor mail subdomain.

  CampaignMonitorMailLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: cm
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      Host label for the Campaign Monitor MX and SPF records. It is deliberately
      different from the apex so it never collides with the G Suite MX records.

  CampaignMonitorMxHost1:
    Type: String
    Default: cmail1.campaignmonitor.com
    Description: (Vendor-supplied) First Campaign Monitor mail exchanger.

  CampaignMonitorMxHost2:
    Type: String
    Default: cmail2.campaignmonitor.com
    Description: (Vendor-supplied) Second Campaign Monitor mail exchanger.

  CampaignMonitorMxHost3:
    Type: String
    Default: cmail3.campaignmonitor.com
    Description: (Vendor-supplied) Third Campaign Monitor mail exchanger.

  # --- Google Workspace DKIM (2048-bit key, published as two 255-char strings) ---

  GoogleDkimRecordPart1:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_DKIM_PUBLIC_KEY_PART_1_OF_2'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) First half (max 255 characters) of the Google Workspace
      DKIM public key record.

  GoogleDkimRecordPart2:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_DKIM_PUBLIC_KEY_PART_2_OF_2'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Second half (max 255 characters) of the Google Workspace
      DKIM public key record.

  # --- Supercast ---

  SupercastDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Default: supercast
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Supercast DKIM selector name.

  SupercastDkimTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_SUPERCAST_DKIM_TARGET.supercast.com
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Supercast DKIM CNAME target.

  SupercastReturnPathLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: rp
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Return-path host label used by Supercast.

  SupercastReturnPathTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_SUPERCAST_RETURN_PATH_TARGET.supercast.com
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Supercast return-path CNAME target.

  FeedsSubdomainLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      Label of the podcast feeds subdomain that is also validated by the ACM
      certificate.

  SupercastFeedsTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_SUPERCAST_FEEDS_TARGET.supercast.com
    Description: >-
      (Vendor-supplied) Supercast podcast distribution hostname that serves the
      feeds subdomain.

Resources:

  EarHustleHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub >-
          Public hosted zone for the Ear Hustle production environment
          (${DomainName}).
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: prx:ops:environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: prx:dev:application
          Value: Ear Hustle

  # Route 53 permits only one TXT record set per name, and the SPF chain must
  # live in a single record. The apex SPF policy, the Google Search Console
  # ownership token and the Zoom domain-claim token are therefore published as
  # three values of this single apex TXT record set.
  ApexTxtRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SpfRecordValue}"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationValue}"'
        - !Sub '"${ZoomDomainVerificationValue}"'

  # MX preferences are the leading integer of each record value.
  ApexMxRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'

  LegacyMailMxRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${LegacyMailSubdomainLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'

  ApexARecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 198.185.159.144
        - 198.185.159.145
        - 198.49.23.144
        - 198.49.23.145

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceSiteTarget

  # Podcast distribution hostname for the feeds subdomain. This is intentionally
  # a separate record from the ACM validation record, which ACM creates under a
  # distinct _<hash> name inside the same zone.
  FeedsCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${FeedsSubdomainLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SupercastFeedsTarget

  # NOTE: Squarespace domain verification is typically published as a TXT record
  # (historically the vendor used a CNAME to verify.squarespace.com). Confirm the
  # current Squarespace console instruction before deployment and change the Type
  # below if the vendor issues a different record form.
  SquarespaceVerificationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'verify.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SquarespaceVerificationValue}"'

  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${DmarcRecordValue}"'

  AtProtoTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_atproto.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${AtProtoDidValue}"'

  # The 2048-bit Google Workspace DKIM key is published as a single TXT record
  # whose value is split into two quoted strings to respect the 255-character
  # per-string DNS limit. Resolvers concatenate the strings back into one key.
  GoogleDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleDkimRecordPart1}" "${GoogleDkimRecordPart2}"'

  ZendeskVerificationTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ZendeskVerificationHostLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ZendeskVerificationValue}"'

  ZendeskHostMappingCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ZendeskHostMappingLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskHostMappingTarget

  ZendeskDkimCnameRecord1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ZendeskDkimSelector1}._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskDkimTarget1

  ZendeskDkimCnameRecord2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ZendeskDkimSelector2}._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskDkimTarget2

  CampaignMonitorDkimCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorDkimSelector}._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref CampaignMonitorDkimTarget

  CampaignMonitorSpfTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorMailLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorSpfValue}"'

  CampaignMonitorMxRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorMailLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '10 ${CampaignMonitorMxHost1}'
        - !Sub '20 ${CampaignMonitorMxHost2}'
        - !Sub '30 ${CampaignMonitorMxHost3}'

  SupercastDkimCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${SupercastDkimSelector}._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SupercastDkimTarget

  SupercastReturnPathCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref EarHustleHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${SupercastReturnPathLabel}.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SupercastReturnPathTarget

  # DNS validation is delegated to ACM through DomainValidationOptions +
  # HostedZoneId, so ACM creates and later cleans up its own validation CNAME
  # record and no manual record (which would collide on the same name) is
  # defined here. If a manually managed validation record is ever required, it
  # must be driven by String Parameters holding the ACM-issued validation name
  # and target - never by Fn::GetAtt of this certificate, which would create an
  # unresolvable cyclic dependency on the first deploy.
  FeedsCertificate:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS App Runner + Amazon ECR + IAM stack for the multi-tenant
  QuickSight dashboard application. Creates the ECR image repository, the App
  Runner ECR access role (build role), the App Runner instance role (task role)
  with Directory Service and QuickSight tenant-provisioning permissions, and the
  App Runner service with an HTTP health check on /status at port 8080.
  No pre-existing infrastructure is referenced; every resource is created here.

# =============================================================================
# IMPORTANT DEPLOYMENT LIMITATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CloudFormation cannot build or push a container image. This stack only creates
# an EMPTY Amazon ECR repository. The App Runner service below references a
# pinned version tag, so the service will fail its initial health check on
# /status until a container image is built and pushed to that exact tag.
#
# The deployment pipeline (or a CodeBuild step / `aws ecr put-image` call) MUST
# build the image, authenticate with `aws ecr get-login-password`, and push the
# pinned tag to this repository BEFORE or ALONGSIDE this stack. No image URI is
# faked here with a fabricated digest or a non-existent tag.
#
# IMMUTABLE TAGS CONTRACT: the repository uses ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE, so
# an existing tag can never be overwritten - a second push to the same tag is
# rejected by ECR. The release workflow is therefore:
#   1. build the image once and push it under a NEW pinned version tag (vX.Y.Z),
#   2. update the ImageUri / ImageIdentifier tag in this template to that tag,
#   3. re-deploy the stack.
# Never reuse a previously pushed tag; always bump the version tag per release.
#
# AUTO-DEPLOYMENTS: `AutoDeploymentsEnabled` is only honoured by App Runner when
# the source is a CodeRepository bound to an existing App Runner `ConnectionArn`
# (GitHub/CodeCommit). It is NOT supported for an ImageRepository source such as
# this one. An App Runner connection cannot be created by CloudFormation and
# there is no `AWS::AppRunner::Connection` resource type, so the property is
# intentionally omitted. To release a new version, push a new immutable tag and
# re-deploy/update the service (CI/CD driven).
#
# HEALTH CHECK PORT: `HealthCheckConfiguration` has NO `Port` key. The
# health-check port is inherited from
# `SourceConfiguration.ImageRepository.ImageConfiguration.Port`, which is set to
# '8080' here and matches the container's documented listener. Do NOT re-add a
# Port property to the HealthCheckConfiguration block.
#
# ECR REPOSITORY POLICY: no resource-based repository policy is attached. The
# private default is least-privilege, and the BuildRole already holds the pull
# permissions it needs via its IAM policy. A `Principal: '*'` statement carrying
# an `ecr:` action would be flagged as public access even as a Deny, so TLS-only
# enforcement belongs at the account/SCP level, not here.
# =============================================================================

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Amazon ECR repository holding the application container image.
  # Retained on stack deletion so images are not destroyed with the stack.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECRRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-quicksight-dashboard'
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      # Tags are IMMUTABLE: an existing tag can never be overwritten, which
      # prevents image-mutation / code-injection via tag re-push. Each release
      # must therefore publish a NEW version tag.
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      # Expire untagged layers quickly and cap tagged image history. The v*
      # prefix matches the pinned version tags used by the service and outputs.
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Expire untagged images after 14 days",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 14
                },
                "action": { "type": "expire" }
              },
              {
                "rulePriority": 2,
                "description": "Keep only the most recent 10 tagged images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "tagged",
                  "tagPrefixList": [ "v" ],
                  "countType": "imageCountMoreThan",
                  "countNumber": 10
                },
                "action": { "type": "expire" }
              }
            ]
          }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build role (App Runner ECR access role): lets App Runner pull the image
  # from ECR on the customer's behalf.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-apprunner-ecr-access'
      Description: App Runner ECR access role for pulling the QuickSight dashboard image
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AppRunnerBuildAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      # AWS-managed policy that grants the standard ECR pull set.
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppRunnerServicePolicyForECRAccess'
      # Explicit inline policy, tightly scoped to this template's repository.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppRunnerECRAccessInline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # ecr:GetAuthorizationToken cannot be resource-scoped; AWS requires "*".
              - Sid: ECRGetAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECRImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                Resource: !GetAtt ECRRepository.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Task role (App Runner instance role): allows the running container to
  # provision tenants in QuickSight and reference the Directory Service.
  # No ecr:*, iam:*, or *:* actions are granted. No managed admin policies.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-apprunner-task'
      Description: App Runner instance role for QuickSight tenant provisioning
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AppRunnerTasksAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightTenantProvisioning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # ds:CreateDirectory must be granted on "*": the target directory
              # ARN does not exist until the directory has been created, so it
              # genuinely cannot be resource-scoped.
              - Sid: DirectoryServiceAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:CreateDirectory
                  - ds:DescribeTrusts
                  - ds:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
              # QuickSight tenant-provisioning actions, scoped to this account
              # and region rather than a bare "*".
              - Sid: QuickSightTenantProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSource
                  - quicksight:CreateTemplate
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeTemplate
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:ListDataSources
                  - quicksight:ListTagsForResource
                  - quicksight:TagResource
                  - quicksight:UntagResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # App Runner service.
  #
  # Observability: App Runner writes service logs to CloudWatch Logs
  # automatically under /aws/apprunner/<service-name>/<service-id>/... . There
  # is no CloudFormation property on AWS::AppRunner::Service that accepts a
  # user-supplied LogGroup ARN, so no separate LogGroup is created here rather
  # than guessing at an unwired resource.
  #
  # Egress: App Runner's default egress reaches the public QuickSight and
  # Directory Service endpoints, so no VPC connector / VPC is required.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-quicksight-dashboard'
      SourceConfiguration:
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt BuildRole.Arn
        ImageRepository:
          # Pinned immutable version tag (v* so it is covered by the lifecycle
          # rule). Bump this tag per release; a re-push of the same tag is
          # rejected by the IMMUTABLE repository.
          ImageIdentifier: !Sub '${ECRRepository.RepositoryUri}:v1.0.0'
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            # Single source of truth for the listening/health-check port.
            Port: '8080'
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              # Network exposure of the application (literal, as requested).
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: 0.0.0.0/0
              # Region and account are resolved at deploy time - never hardcoded.
              - Name: AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              # Clearly dummy, non-secret placeholder admin contact.
              - Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
                Value: admin@example.com
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: admin
              # QuickSight configuration identifiers (non-secret). No passwords,
              # API keys, or client secrets are placed in plain text here; a
              # future credential should be created via AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
              # and only its ARN passed in.
              - Name: QS_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: quicksight-multitenant-template
              - Name: QS_DATASET_ID
                Value: quicksight-multitenant-dataset
              - Name: QS_DATASOURCE_ID
                Value: quicksight-multitenant-datasource
              - Name: QS_DATABASE_NAME
                Value: analytics
              - Name: QS_TABLE_NAME
                Value: tenant_events
              - Name: QS_FILTER_COLUMN
                Value: tenant_id
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: '1024'
        Memory: '2048'
        InstanceRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      # HealthCheckConfiguration has NO `Port` key. The health-check port is
      # inherited from ImageConfiguration.Port ('8080' above), so only the
      # remaining supported properties are set here.
      HealthCheckConfiguration:
        Protocol: HTTP
        Path: /status
        Interval: 10
        Timeout: 5
        HealthyThreshold: 2
        UnhealthyThreshold: 5
      # NOTE: AutoDeploymentsEnabled is intentionally omitted - it is only
      # supported for CodeRepository sources with an App Runner ConnectionArn,
      # not for the ECR ImageRepository source used here.
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

Outputs:
  ImageUri:
    Description: ECR image URI of the pinned immutable tag the pipeline must build and push
    Value: !Sub '${ECRRepository.RepositoryUri}:v1.0.0'

  ServiceUrl:
    Description: Public URL of the App Runner service
    Value: !GetAtt AppRunnerService.ServiceUrl

  ServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the App Runner service
    Value: !GetAtt AppRunnerService.ServiceArn

  ECRRepositoryUri:
    Description: URI of the ECR repository created by this stack
    Value: !GetAtt ECRRepository.RepositoryUri

  AccessRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the App Runner ECR access (build) role
    Value: !GetAtt BuildRole.Arn

  TaskRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the App Runner instance (task) role
    Value: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
