final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice stack with private AWS Cloud Map service
  discovery. The template creates its own VPC (one public subnet, two private subnets
  in separate Availability Zones, internet gateway and NAT gateway), an ECS cluster,
  task definition and task execution role, a CloudWatch log group, a private Cloud Map
  namespace with an SRV service that each task registers into, VPC endpoints so private
  tasks can pull images and write logs without public egress, and Application Auto
  Scaling between 2 and 10 tasks driven by high and low CPU CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    Description: Environment name used as a prefix for resource names and tags.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: web-service
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 30
    Description: Name of the microservice; used for ECS, Cloud Map and log group naming.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    MinLength: 1
    Description: >-
      Container image URI the Fargate task runs. The default nginx image listens
      on port 80.

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: >-
      Container port mapped in the task definition, opened in the security group
      and registered in Cloud Map.

  TaskCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '256'
    Description: Fargate task CPU units (for example 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096).

  TaskMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    Description: Fargate task memory in MiB (for example 512, 1024, 2048).

  DesiredTaskCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Number of tasks the ECS service starts with.

  TaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of the IAM role the containers can assume to access other AWS
      resources. Leave empty to run with the task execution role only.

Conditions:

  HasTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, '']]

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # Networking
  ##############################################################################

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  NATElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NATGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ##############################################################################
  # VPC endpoints (private access to image layers, logs and ECR without public egress)
  ##############################################################################

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpce'
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Inbound HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS from resources in the VPC to the interface endpoints
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS responses to resources in the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpce'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ##############################################################################
  # Security group for the Fargate tasks
  ##############################################################################

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-tasks'
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Container traffic for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} scoped to the VPC CIDR'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Container port from other containers in the VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS from in-VPC service endpoints to the tasks
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Container port to other containers in the VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS to in-VPC service endpoints (VPC endpoints)
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-tasks'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # Logging and IAM
  ##############################################################################

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'
      Description: !Sub 'ECS task execution role for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ContainerLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${LogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # ECS cluster, task definition and service
  ##############################################################################

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - HasTaskRole
        - !Ref TaskRoleArn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # Cloud Map private service discovery
  ##############################################################################

  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}.local'
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}.local'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Cloud Map service used by ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} tasks'
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 30
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateRoute
      - PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredTaskCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # Application Auto Scaling
  ##############################################################################

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService.Name}'
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 4

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -2

  ##############################################################################
  # CloudWatch alarms driving the scaling policies
  ##############################################################################

  HighCPUAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-high-cpu'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Scale out ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} when average CPU is at or above 70 percent'
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demonstrations with an
  OCI primary region. Creates a VPC, internet gateway, private subnet in the first
  available AZ, route table, transit gateway with explicit route table and VPC
  attachment, a tightly scoped HTTPS security group, optional static-route VPN to OCI,
  and KMS-encrypted VPC flow logs delivered to a 30-day CloudWatch log group.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  InternalAccessCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: Internal CIDR range permitted to reach HTTPS on the backbone security group.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.16.0.0/16
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR used for the security group HTTPS egress rule and the transit gateway route.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  CustomerGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.1
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI VPN endpoint (documentation-safe default).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

  EnableOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: When 'true', provision the customer gateway, static VPN connection and OCI transit gateway route.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: hybrid-demo
    Description: Environment tag applied to all resources.

Conditions:
  CreateOciVpn: !Equals [!Ref EnableOciVpn, 'true']

Resources:

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TgwRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TgwVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attach'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TgwVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TgwRouteTable

  TgwRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TgwVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TgwRouteTable

  TgwVpnRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpnConnection
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TgwRouteTable

  BackboneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Hybrid backbone security group: HTTPS ingress from the internal CIDR only and
        HTTPS egress to the OCI backbone CIDR only.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalAccessCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS from the configurable internal CIDR range.
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS outbound to the OCI backbone CIDR only.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-backbone-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      IpAddress: !Ref CustomerGatewayIp
      # BgpAsn is mandatory in the schema and is ignored for static-only routing.
      BgpAsn: 65000
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-cgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      # Static routes only: no BGP/dynamic routing options are configured.
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpnConnectionRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VpnConnection

  TgwRouteForOci:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      # Single static, non-propagated route directing OCI traffic to the VPN attachment.
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TgwRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpnConnection

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key for VPC flow log encryption (${AWS::StackName}).'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToCloudWatch
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: UseFlowLogsKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet created in the first available AZ.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetId'

  BackboneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the hybrid backbone security group.
    Value: !Ref BackboneSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BackboneSecurityGroupId'

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway.
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayId'

  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group receiving VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroupName'

  FlowLogsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting flow logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKeyArn'

  VpnConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Description: ID of the OCI VPN connection (static routes only).
    Value: !Ref VpnConnection
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpnConnectionId'

  CustomerGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Description: ID of the OCI customer gateway.
    Value: !Ref CustomerGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CustomerGatewayId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained test stack: a DynamoDB table keyed on USER_ID with on-demand
  billing and point-in-time recovery, plus a comprehensive set of CloudWatch
  alarms (AWS/DynamoDB namespace) monitoring write throttle events, throttled
  requests, conditional check failures, user/system errors, transaction
  conflicts, online index throttle events, successful request latency,
  table-level and account-level read/write capacity utilization, and
  replication metrics. No external VPCs, subnets, secrets, SSM parameters,
  exports, or hardcoded identifiers are referenced.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: testing-table
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB test table. Must be unique within the account/region.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB test table: single HASH key USER_ID, on-demand, PITR enabled.
  # Data is retained on stack update replacement and stack deletion.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Table-level alarms (AWS/DynamoDB namespace, 60-second period)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'WriteThrottleEvents for table ${TableName} is greater than or equal to 1 (Sum) over 1 period of 60 seconds.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestingTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  PiBot authentication stack. Creates two self-contained Amazon Cognito setups:
  (1) the PiBot web application - user pool, browser/SPA user pool client, identity
  pool with unauthenticated access enabled, plus authenticated and unauthenticated
  IAM roles covering IoT, Kinesis Video Streams, Rekognition, Cognito and mobile
  analytics actions; and (2) the PiBot trusted-user provisioner - user pool limited
  to admin-created users, its client, identity pool with unauthenticated access
  disabled, and a single authenticated role for IoT trusted-user provisioning.
  Every resource is created by this template: no external infrastructure, no
  cross-stack imports, and no dynamic references to pre-existing secrets or
  parameters.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiBot
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: >-
      Project prefix used for naming and tagging every resource created by this
      template ("-Web-*" for the application, "-Provisioning-*" for the
      trusted-user provisioner).

Resources:

  #############################################################################
  # 1. Main web application - user pool, client, identity pool
  #############################################################################

  WebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    # Stateful resource: keep the pool (and its users) if the stack is deleted
    # or the resource is replaced.
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Web-UserPool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 14
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      EmailConfiguration:
        # Cognito's built-in sender (no SES identity is created or referenced).
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: prod
        Component: WebApp

  WebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    # Note: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient does not expose a Tags property, so the
    # client is identified by its name prefix instead of tags.
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Web-Client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref WebAppUserPool
      # Public browser/mobile client: it cannot keep a secret.
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AuthSessionValidity: 5

  WebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Web-IdentityPool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref WebAppUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${WebAppUserPool}'
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod
        - Key: Component
          Value: WebApp

  #############################################################################
  # 2. Main web application - authenticated role and access policy
  #############################################################################

  WebAppAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Web-AuthenticatedRole'
      Description: !Sub 'Authenticated role for the ${ProjectName} web application identity pool.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCognitoAuthenticatedWebIdentity
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Web-AuthenticatedAccess'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTCoreConnect
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                Resource:
                  # Scoped to the caller's own Cognito identity, which is used as the
                  # MQTT client ID. The trailing value is an IAM policy variable and
                  # must be passed through literally, so it is assembled with Fn::Join
                  # instead of Fn::Sub so CloudFormation does not try to resolve it.
                  - !Join
                    - ''
                    - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:client/'
                      - '${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}'
              - Sid: IoTPublishAndReceive
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Receive
                Resource:
                  # Narrow to "topic/<your-topic-space>/*" once the PiBot topic
                  # namespace is fixed.
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topic/*'
              - Sid: IoTSubscribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Subscribe
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topicfilter/*'
              - Sid: IoTDescribeEndpoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                # iot:DescribeEndpoint does not support resource-level permissions.
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IoTDeviceShadows
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:thing/*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreamAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesisvideo:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoListStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                # kinesisvideo:ListStreams does not support resource-level permissions.
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                  - rekognition:RecognizeCelebrities
                # Rekognition image-analysis actions operate on the image supplied in
                # the request body and do not support resource-level permissions.
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityAndSync
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                  - cognito-sync:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AWS::Region}:${WebAppIdentityPool}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AWS::Region}:${WebAppIdentityPool}'
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsPutEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                # mobileanalytics:PutEvents does not support resource-level permissions.
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod
        - Key: Component
          Value: WebApp

  #############################################################################
  # 3. Main web application - unauthenticated role (read/connect only)
  #############################################################################

  WebAppUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Web-UnauthenticatedRole'
      Description: !Sub 'Unauthenticated (guest) role for the ${ProjectName} web application identity pool. Read/connect only.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCognitoUnauthenticatedWebIdentity
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Web-UnauthenticatedAccess'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityCredentials
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  # Required so the guest identity can obtain temporary credentials.
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AWS::Region}:${WebAppIdentityPool}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'
              - Sid: IoTCoreConnect
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                Resource:
                  - !Join
                    - ''
                    - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:client/'
                      - '${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}'
              - Sid: IoTDescribeEndpoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                # iot:DescribeEndpoint does not support resource-level permissions.
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KinesisVideoReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesisvideo:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/*'
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsPutEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                # mobileanalytics:PutEvents does not support resource-level permissions.
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod
        - Key: Component
          Value: WebApp

  WebAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt WebAppAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt WebAppUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  #############################################################################
  # 4. Trusted-user provisioner - user pool, client, identity pool
  #############################################################################

  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    # Stateful resource: keep the pool (and its users) if the stack is deleted
    # or the resource is replaced.
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Provisioning-UserPool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: ON
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 14
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      # Only trusted administrators may create provisioner users - no self sign-up.
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: prod
        Component: Provisioning

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    # Note: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient does not expose a Tags property, so the
    # client is identified by its name prefix instead of tags.
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Provisioning-Client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        # Back-end provisioner flows only: admin-initiated and SRP sign-in.
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 15
      IdTokenValidity: 15
      TokenValidityUnits:

        RefreshToken: days

  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Provisioning-IdentityPool'
      # No untrusted access path exists for provisioning.
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      AllowClassicFlow: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:

          ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ProvisioningUserPool}'

        - Key: Environment

          Value: Provisioning

  #############################################################################
  # 5. Trusted-user provisioner - authenticated role and IoT provisioning policy
  #############################################################################

  ProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Provisioning-AuthenticatedRole'
      Description: !Sub 'Authenticated role for the ${ProjectName} trusted-user provisioning identity pool.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:

                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Provisioning-IoTAccess'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityCredentials
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AWS::Region}:${ProvisioningIdentityPool}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'
              - Sid: IoTThingProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:CreateThing
                  - iot:RegisterThing
                  - iot:UpdateThing
                  - iot:DescribeThing
                  - iot:DeleteThing
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:thing/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:provisioningtemplate/*'
              - Sid: IoTListThings
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

              - Sid: IoTCertificateProvisioning

              - Sid: IoTPolicyManagement

      Tags:

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Wires up an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP-based protein variant
  effect prediction tooling. This stack provisions the AgentCore Gateway, its
  IAM execution role, the Lambda-backed MCP gateway target (inline tool schema
  with invoke_endpoint / get_results), the ProjectName-scoped SSM parameters the
  stack consumes, and an SSM parameter that publishes the new execution role
  ARN. It does not provision backend compute or identity providers: the
  prediction Lambda ARN and the Cognito custom-JWT authorizer settings are
  self-created SSM parameters seeded with safe placeholders (or real values via
  optional seed inputs) and consumed through Fn::GetAtt.

# =============================================================================
# GREENFIELD STRATEGY - SSM SEEDED IN-STACK (Grounded Objective 9, approach (a))
#
# This account is greenfield and contains no pre-existing SSM parameters, so
# reading external parameters cannot deploy. Instead this stack SELF-CREATES the
# three SSM parameters its consumers depend on:
#   /${ProjectName}/lambda/arn             -> prediction Lambda ARN
#   /${ProjectName}/cognito/discovery-url  -> OIDC discovery URL
#   /${ProjectName}/cognito/client-id      -> allowed Cognito app client ID
#
# Each parameter is seeded with a syntactically valid, non-account-specific
# placeholder built from pseudo parameters (AWS::Partition / AWS::Region /
# AWS::AccountId) and ProjectName. To inject real values at deploy time, supply
# the optional LambdaArnSeed / CognitoDiscoveryUrlSeed / CognitoClientIdSeed
# parameters; alternatively overwrite the parameters after deploy with
# PutParameter. Consumers read the created parameters via Fn::GetAtt
# <Parameter>.Value, which creates a real CloudFormation dependency and
# guarantees create-before-consume ordering (dynamic {{resolve:ssm:...}}
# references are NOT dependency-tracked and would race the parameter creation).
#
# No passwords, client secrets, API keys, or tokens appear in this template;
# the discovery URL, client ID, and Lambda ARN are non-sensitive identifiers.
# secretsmanager / ssm-secure dynamic references are not used because those
# resources do not exist in this account.
# =============================================================================

Parameters:

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 24
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-24 characters of lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
    Description: >-
      Prefix applied to every resource name and SSM parameter path created or
      consumed by this stack.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: MCP gateway exposing protein variant effect prediction tools to AI agents
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Human-readable description applied to the AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 48
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: >-
      Optional AgentCore Gateway name. Leave blank to auto-generate
      "<ProjectName>-gateway".

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used for resource tagging.

  LambdaArnSeed:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 2048
    Description: >-
      Optional real ARN of the prediction Lambda. When blank, a placeholder ARN
      is seeded into /<ProjectName>/lambda/arn.

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlSeed:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 2048
    Description: >-
      Optional real Cognito OIDC discovery URL (ending in
      /.well-known/openid-configuration). When blank, a placeholder URL is
      seeded into /<ProjectName>/cognito/discovery-url.

  CognitoClientIdSeed:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: >-
      Optional real Cognito app client ID allowed to call the gateway. When
      blank, a placeholder identifier is seeded into
      /<ProjectName>/cognito/client-id.

Conditions:

  GatewayNameProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']]
  UseLambdaArnSeed: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LambdaArnSeed, '']]
  UseCognitoDiscoveryUrlSeed: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrlSeed, '']]
  UseCognitoClientIdSeed: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CognitoClientIdSeed, '']]

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Consumed SSM parameters, self-created with safe placeholder values (or real
  # values from the optional seed inputs). Consumers use Fn::GetAtt on these
  # resources, so CloudFormation creates them before the gateway, role, and
  # target that read them.
  #
  # Tagging note: AWS::SSM::Parameter uses MAP form for Tags.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PredictionLambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/lambda/arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !If
        - UseLambdaArnSeed
        - !Ref LambdaArnSeed
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${ProjectName}-prediction'
      Description: !Sub 'Placeholder ARN of the protein variant effect prediction Lambda for project ${ProjectName}; overwrite with the real ARN.'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !If
        - UseCognitoDiscoveryUrlSeed
        - !Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrlSeed
        - !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ProjectName}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: !Sub 'Placeholder Cognito OIDC discovery URL used by the ${ProjectName} AgentCore Gateway JWT authorizer; overwrite with the real URL.'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/cognito/client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !If
        - UseCognitoClientIdSeed
        - !Ref CognitoClientIdSeed
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-placeholder-client-id'
      Description: !Sub 'Placeholder Cognito app client ID allowed to call the ${ProjectName} AgentCore Gateway; overwrite with the real client ID.'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway execution role. Trust is scoped to the AgentCore gateway service;
  # the only permission granted is synchronous invocation of the single
  # prediction Lambda whose ARN is read from the created SSM parameter.
  # lambda:InvokeAsync is intentionally not granted: an MCP Lambda target
  # invokes the function synchronously.
  #
  # Tagging note: AWS::IAM::Role uses the standard list-of-{Key,Value} tag shape
  # (see AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway below, which uses map form).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role assumed by the ${ProjectName} Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke the protein variant effect prediction Lambda'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreGatewayAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-invoke-prediction-lambda'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokePredictionLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PredictionLambdaArnParameter.Value
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore Gateway (MCP) guarded by a custom JWT authorizer. The authorizer
  # values (OIDC discovery URL and allowed client ID) are read via Fn::GetAtt
  # from the SSM parameters created above, which gives the gateway an implicit
  # dependency on both parameter resources. No Cognito resources are created and
  # no issuer values are hardcoded.
  #
  # Tagging note: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway declares Tags as a plain
  # key -> value MAP, NOT the list-of-{Key,Value} form used by IAM roles and SSM
  # parameters. Do not convert this block to list form.
  #
  # Schema note: protocol/version tuning properties are intentionally omitted
  # because their exact CloudFormation property names could not be confirmed.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - GatewayNameProvided
        - !Ref GatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !GetAtt CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter.Value
          AllowedClients:
            - !GetAtt CognitoClientIdParameter.Value
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MCP gateway target that connects the gateway to the prediction Lambda and
  # declares its two inline tool operations. The Lambda ARN is read via
  # Fn::GetAtt from the created SSM parameter, so the target is created after
  # it. Credential provider configuration is omitted: Lambda targets use the
  # gateway execution role (GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE) by default.
  #
  # Tagging note: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget exposes NO Tags property
  # in its resource schema, so no tag block is emitted here (list or map form
  # would both be invalid). Cost/ownership attribution for this target flows
  # through the tags on its parent gateway and on the gateway execution role.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProteinVariantEffectTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-protein-variant-effect'
      Description: >-
        MCP target exposing the protein variant effect prediction Lambda as the
        invoke_endpoint and get_results tools.
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt PredictionLambdaArnParameter.Value
          ToolSchema:
            InlinePayload:
              - Name: invoke_endpoint
                Description: >-
                  Submit one or more protein sequences, optionally with amino
                  acid substitutions, for variant effect prediction. Returns a
                  job identifier that can be polled with get_results.
                InputSchema:
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    sequences:
                      Type: array
                      Description: Protein sequences to score, one entry per sequence.
                      MinItems: 1
                      Items:
                        Type: string
                    variants:
                      Type: array
                      Description: Optional variant definitions to evaluate against the submitted sequences.
                      Items:
                        Type: object
                        Properties:
                          sequence_id:
                            Type: string
                            Description: Identifier of the sequence the substitutions apply to.
                          substitutions:
                            Type: array
                            Description: Substitutions in "<ref><position><alt>" notation, for example "A123V".
                            MinItems: 1
                            Items:
                              Type: string
                        Required:
                          - sequence_id
                          - substitutions
                        AdditionalProperties: false
                    model_name:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Optional identifier of the prediction model or checkpoint to use.
                  Required:
                    - sequences
                  AdditionalProperties: false
              - Name: get_results
                Description: >-
                  Check the status of a previously submitted variant effect
                  prediction job and return its status plus per-variant scores
                  once the job has completed.
                InputSchema:
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    job_id:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Job identifier returned by invoke_endpoint.
                  Required:
                    - job_id
                  AdditionalProperties: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Publishes the newly created execution role ARN so downstream stacks and
  # operators can discover it without importing anything from this stack.
  # Tagging note: AWS::SSM::Parameter uses MAP form for Tags.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayExecutionRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/gateway/iam-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: !Sub 'ARN of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway execution role for project ${ProjectName}.'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

Outputs:

  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn

  # Output logical name retained for consumer-contract stability; the referenced
  # attribute is the documented return value GatewayIdentifier.
  GatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayIdentifier

  # Attribute set confirmed by the validator: CreatedAt, GatewayArn,
  # GatewayIdentifier, GatewayUrl, Status, StatusReasons, UpdatedAt,
  # WorkloadIdentityDetails. GatewayUrl is a documented return value.
  GatewayUrl:
    Description: MCP endpoint URL clients use to reach the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayUrl

  GatewayExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role the gateway assumes to invoke the prediction Lambda.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn

  GatewayTargetId:
    Description: Identifier of the MCP gateway target that connects the gateway to the prediction Lambda.
    Value: !Ref ProteinVariantEffectTarget

  GatewayExecutionRoleArnSsmParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter that stores the gateway execution role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayExecutionRoleArnParameter

  PredictionLambdaArnSsmParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter holding the prediction Lambda ARN consumed by the gateway target.
    Value: !Ref PredictionLambdaArnParameter

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlSsmParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter holding the Cognito OIDC discovery URL consumed by the gateway authorizer.
    Value: !Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter

  CognitoClientIdSsmParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter holding the Cognito client ID consumed by the gateway authorizer.
    Value: !Ref CognitoClientIdParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Audit event messaging stack: KMS-encrypted SQS audit events queue with an optional
  dead letter queue for non-dev environments, a KMS-encrypted SNS topic for alarm
  notifications, and CloudWatch alarms on message age and DLQ activity. All
  resources are defined inline in this template.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment. Drives DLQ creation, retention, visibility timeout and alarm thresholds.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Description: Naming prefix applied to every resource created by this stack.
    Default: audit
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Optional email address for alarm notifications. Leave empty to create no
      subscription. Email subscriptions require manual confirmation and never
      block stack completion.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  CreateDlq: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, 'dev']]
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, '']]
  IsDev: !Equals [!Ref Environment, 'dev']
  IsStaging: !Equals [!Ref Environment, 'staging']
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, 'prod']

Mappings:
  EnvConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: '86400'
      VisibilityTimeout: '30'
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: '345600'
      VisibilityTimeout: '60'
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: '1209600'
      VisibilityTimeout: '120'

Resources:

  AuditEventsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed KMS key for ${ProjectName} ${Environment} audit event messaging'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-audit-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-audit-events'
                  - !If
                    - CreateDlq
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-audit-events-dlq'
                    - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt

  AuditEventsQueuePolicy:

            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource:

  AuditAlarmTopic:

      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn

  AuditAlarmEmailSubscription:

    Condition: HasAlarmEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

  AuditEventsOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-audit-events-old-messages'

      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: !If
        - IsDev
        - 1
        - !If
          - IsStaging
          - 2
          - 3
      Threshold: !If
        - IsDev
        - 1800
        - !If
          - IsStaging
          - 3600
          - 7200
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

  AuditEventsDlqMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateDlq

      Namespace: AWS/SQS

      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName

      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:

  AuditEventsDlqQueueArn:
