AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CryptoTickerAPI - self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL stack for cryptocurrency ticker
  data. Deploys the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API (API key authentication) with an inline
  GraphQL schema, the APIDataTable DynamoDB table (composite hk/sk primary key, on-demand
  billing, server-side encryption disabled, data retained on stack deletion), an AppSync
  HTTP data source for the public CoinGecko price API, an AppSync DynamoDB data source,
  two AppSync pipeline functions with the Query.ticker pipeline resolver and the
  TickerInfo.priceHistory query resolver, the AppSync IAM service role, and the default
  API key. The stack is fully self-contained and references no pre-existing infrastructure.

Resources:

  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CryptoTickerAPIDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TickerHistoryTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${APIDataTable.Arn}/*'

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  CryptoTickerAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TickerInfoConnection
        }

        type TickerInfoConnection {
          items: [TickerInfo]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type TickerInfoEdge {
          cursor: String!
          node: TickerInfo
        }

        type PageInfo {
          hasNextPage: Boolean!
          hasPreviousPage: Boolean!
          startCursor: String
          endCursor: String
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoHTTPDataSource
      Description: HTTP data source for the public CoinGecko price API
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  APIDataTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source for the APIDataTable ticker history table
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        UseCallerCredentials: false

  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: fetchTickerPriceFromCoinGecko
      Description: Fetches the current USD price for the requested ticker from CoinGecko
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ctx.args.ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            },
            "headers": {
              "Accept": "application/json"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $ctx.args.ticker)
        #set($price = $null)
        #if($ctx.result && $ctx.result.get($ticker))
          #set($price = $ctx.result.get($ticker).get("usd"))
        #end
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("ticker", $ticker))
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("price", $price))
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  StoreTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: storeTickerPriceHistory
      Description: Persists the fetched price as a historical record in APIDataTable
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $ctx.stash.ticker)
        #set($price = $ctx.stash.price)
        #set($timestamp = $util.time.nowISO8601())
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("timestamp", $timestamp))
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ticker),
            "price": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StoreTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({"ticker": $ctx.stash.ticker, "price": $ctx.stash.price, "timestamp": $ctx.stash.timestamp})

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($limit = 25)
        #if($ctx.args.limit)
          #set($limit = $ctx.args.limit)
        #end
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :ticker",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.source.ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $limit,
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.args.nextToken)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({"items": $ctx.result.items, "nextToken": $ctx.result.nextToken})

  CryptoTickerApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API

Outputs:

  GraphQLApiEndpoint:
    Description: HTTPS endpoint of the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl

  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: ID of the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId

  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.Arn

  ApiKeyId:
    Description: >-
      ID of the default AppSync API key. CloudFormation does not expose the API key value;
      retrieve it with "aws appsync list-api-keys --api-id <GraphQLApiId>".
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApiKey.ApiKeyId

  DataTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores ticker price history
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable

  AppSyncServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the AppSync IAM service role assumed for data source access
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS Elemental MediaPackage live channel with HLS and DASH origin
  endpoints and optional live-to-VOD archiving. When live-to-VOD is enabled,
  origin endpoint origination is set to DENY. Note: CloudFormation does not
  provide a resource type for MediaPackage live-to-VOD harvest jobs; the
  harvest job must be triggered outside of this template.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: media-live
    Description: Prefix used to name resources created by this template.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: HLS segment duration in seconds.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 86400
    Description: Startover window in seconds for both origin endpoints.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name used for the HLS and DASH manifests.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    Description: Desired output type; surfaced as a stack output.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value applied to all taggable resources.
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag key. When empty, only the Environment tag is applied.
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag value used with CustomTagKey.
  LiveToVodEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, provision live-to-VOD archiving resources and set origination to DENY.

Conditions:
  LiveToVodEnabled: !Equals [!Ref LiveToVodEnabled, 'true']
  HasCustomTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, '']]

Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'MediaPackage live channel for ${NamePrefix}'
      Tags: !If
        - HasCustomTag
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-hls'
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix}'
      Origination: !If [LiveToVodEnabled, DENY, ALLOW]
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      Tags: !If
        - HasCustomTag
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-dash'
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix}'
      Origination: !If [LiveToVodEnabled, DENY, ALLOW]
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Tags: !If
        - HasCustomTag
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment

  MediaPackageVodKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: LiveToVodEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for MediaPackage live-to-VOD buckets (${NamePrefix})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags: !If
        - HasCustomTag
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: LiveToVodEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-archive-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref MediaPackageVodKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags: !If
        - HasCustomTag
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: LiveToVodEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-source-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref MediaPackageVodKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags: !If
        - HasCustomTag
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: LiveToVodEnabled
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-bucket-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MediaPackageVodKey.Arn
      Tags: !If
        - HasCustomTag
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment

  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: LiveToVodEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'

  VodSourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: LiveToVodEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

              - kms:ReEncryptTo
            Resource: '*'

          - Sid: EKSServiceLinkedRoles

  NodesManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: aws.cluster.x-k8s.io-nodes
      Description: EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager, SSM and S3 permissions used by Cluster API Provider AWS worker nodes.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Read
            Effect: Allow
            Action:

              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRRepositoryRead

              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
          - Sid: ECRAuthorizationToken
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ClusterSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: SSMParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/aws/service/eks/*'
          - Sid: SSMAgent
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: S3BootstrapAssets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::cluster-api-provider-aws-*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::cluster-api-provider-aws-*/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 instances running the Cluster API Provider AWS control plane manager.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneManagedPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksManagedPolicy

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Role assumed by the Cluster API Provider AWS controllers running on EC2 and by EKS pod identities.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: EKSPodIdentityAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersManagedPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksManagedPolicy

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Role assumed by Cluster API Provider AWS worker nodes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref NodesManagedPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy

  EksControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io

        Version: '2012-10-17'

      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:

    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Builds custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for both the x86_64 and arm64 architectures with
  EC2 Image Builder. A shared build component installs Docker, the Docker Compose plugin and
  the synapseclient, pandas and pysftp Python packages, enables passwordless sudo for the SSM
  user, and then validates the installation in a test phase. Two image recipes (x86_64 and
  arm64) share one infrastructure configuration and one distribution configuration that makes
  the resulting AMIs public, shares them with a specified AWS Organization, and tags the AMIs
  with the stack name. Build notifications are published to a customer-managed KMS-encrypted
  SNS topic.

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    Description: >-
      Semantic version applied to both image recipes and to the shared Image Builder component.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Size in GiB of the root EBS volume of the built AMI.

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-exampleorgid'
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    Description: >-
      AWS Organizations ID that the resulting AMIs are shared with through launch permissions.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the Image Builder notification topic
  ###############################################################################

  ImageBuilderTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${AWS::StackName} EC2 Image Builder SNS topic.'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAwsServicesToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sns.amazonaws.com
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ImageBuilderTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-notifications'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderTopicKey

  ###############################################################################
  # Notification topic (created in this stack to avoid external dependencies)
  ###############################################################################

  ImageBuilderNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-notifications'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} EC2 Image Builder notifications'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderTopicKey
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM role and instance profile used by the Image Builder build instances
  ###############################################################################

  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role'
      Description: Role assumed by the EC2 build instances launched by EC2 Image Builder.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEc2ToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by the EC2 Image Builder service to run the pipelines
  ###############################################################################

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-service-role'
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder to create, build and distribute the images.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderRuntimeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassBuildInstanceRoleToEc2
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildInstanceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ec2.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ReadBuildInstanceRoleConfiguration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                  - iam:ListInstanceProfilesForRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BuildAndImageLifecycle
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetImagePipeline
                  - imagebuilder:GetWorkflow
                  - imagebuilder:GetWorkflowStepExecution
                  - imagebuilder:GetWorkflowExecution
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponents
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageRecipes
                  - imagebuilder:ListInfrastructureConfigurations
                  - imagebuilder:ListDistributionConfigurations
                  - imagebuilder:ListImagePipelines
                  - imagebuilder:ListWorkflows
                  - imagebuilder:ListTagsForResource
                  - imagebuilder:CreateImage
                  - imagebuilder:CreateImagePipeline
                  - imagebuilder:DeleteImage
                  - imagebuilder:DeleteImagePipeline
                  - imagebuilder:StartImagePipelineExecution
                  - imagebuilder:CancelImageCreation
                  - imagebuilder:TagResource
                  - imagebuilder:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2BuildInfrastructure
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                  - ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EncryptedNotificationPublishing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderTopicKey.Arn
              - Sid: ArtifactStorageAndNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:PutBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - sns:Publish
                  - sns:ListTopics
                  - sns:GetTopicAttributes
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Shared build component: Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, SSM sudo
  ###############################################################################

  SoftwareInstallationComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-docker-python'
      Description: >-
        Installs Docker, the Docker Compose plugin and the synapseclient, pandas and pysftp
        Python packages, enables passwordless sudo for the ssm-user account, and validates
        the installation in the test phase.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - 'Amazon Linux 2023'
      Data: |
        name: Al2023DockerPythonComponent
        description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages, then validates them.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDockerEngine
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf install -y docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerComposePlugin
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - mkdir -p /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins
                    - curl -fsSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod 0755 /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf install -y python3 python3-pip
                    - python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: ConfigureSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: ValidateDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - docker --version
                    - docker compose version
              - name: ValidatePythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Image recipes (x86_64 and arm64) built from the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI
  ###############################################################################

  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86_64'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 image with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallationComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        Architecture: x86_64
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 image with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64}}'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallationComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        Architecture: arm64
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  # No VPC/subnet/security group is referenced: this is a greenfield account, so
  # Image Builder launches the build instances in the account default VPC.
  ###############################################################################

  ImageInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure'
      Description: Shared build infrastructure for the Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 and arm64 images.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
        - t4g.medium
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      SnsTopicArn: !Ref ImageBuilderNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Shared distribution configuration
  # The resulting AMIs are published publicly and shared with the organization.
  # NOTE: the formal organization ARN is
  # arn:<partition>:organizations::<management-account-id>:organization/<org-id>.
  # The management account ID is not known to this template, so the ARN is built
  # from the current account ID; if the pipeline runs in a member account, replace
  # ${AWS::AccountId} (or set the parameter to the management-account-scoped ARN).
  # Image Builder applies the AMI tags below to the produced AMIs and propagates
  # them to the underlying EBS snapshots it creates.
  ###############################################################################

  ImageDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: >-
        Distributes the AMIs in the current Region with public launch permissions and
        organization-level sharing.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 image built by ${AWS::StackName}'
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
              StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
              Environment: production
              ManagedBy: EC2ImageBuilder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Image pipelines (one per architecture, each bound to its own recipe)
  ###############################################################################

  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-x86_64'
      Description: Builds and distributes the Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Tags:
        StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
        Architecture: x86_64

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel - Cognito authentication stack (guest + staff). Creates a PLUS tier
  user pool with advanced security enforced, email sign-in, admin-only user creation,
  custom guest/property/region attributes, an SPA client (SRP), a server-side admin auth
  client, an M2M OAuth2 client with a resource server (read/write/admin scopes), six staff
  role groups, and a hosted UI domain.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    AllowedPattern: '^(dev|staging|prod)$'
    Description: >-
      Deployment environment for the AnyCompany Hotel Cognito authentication stack.
      Drives resource naming, group naming, the user pool domain prefix, and export names.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User Pool - holds all guest and staff identities (stateful, retained).
  # No EmailConfiguration is set: this greenfield account has no verified SES
  # identity, so Cognito's built-in default email sender is used for the
  # verified_email recovery flow and AutoVerifiedAttributes (email).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AnyCompanyHotelUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool'
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
          PasswordHistorySize: 24
      Schema:
        - Name: 'custom:guest_id'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: 'custom:property_id'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: 'custom:region'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Application: AnyCompanyHotel

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public SPA client - SRP only, no secret, 1h access/id, 30d refresh.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SpaUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dedicated admin auth client - server-side test harnesses and simulators.
  # No secret, ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH only, same token lifetimes.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resource server backing the M2M OAuth2 client scopes.
  # Does NOT reference the client (no circular dependency).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HotelApiResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: anycompany-hotel-api
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # M2M OAuth2 client - client_credentials flow, Cognito-generated secret
  # (never written into the template). Scope strings match the resource
  # server Identifier/ScopeName pairs exactly.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  M2MUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: HotelApiResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - anycompany-hotel-api/read
        - anycompany-hotel-api/write
        - anycompany-hotel-api/admin
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Staff role groups - namespaced with the Environment for isolation,
  # e.g. 'dev-Admin', 'prod-Housekeeping'.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-Admin'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      Description: Hotel system administrators with full administrative access.

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-Manager'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      Description: Property managers with operational oversight of a single hotel.

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-RegionalManager'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      Description: Regional managers overseeing multiple AnyCompany Hotel properties.

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-RevenueManager'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      Description: Revenue managers controlling rates, inventory, and pricing strategy.

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-FrontDesk'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      Description: Front desk staff handling guest check-in and guest services.

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-Housekeeping'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
      Description: Housekeeping staff managing room status and cleaning workflow.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI / OAuth2 domain. Globally unique prefix built from the
  # environment and the account context (never a hardcoded account ID).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AnyCompanyHotelUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool

Outputs:

  UserPoolId:
    Description: AnyCompany Hotel Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-AnyCompanyHotel-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: AnyCompany Hotel Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt AnyCompanyHotelUserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-AnyCompanyHotel-UserPoolArn'

  SpaClientId:
    Description: Client ID for the public SPA client (SRP auth, no secret).
    Value: !Ref SpaUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-AnyCompanyHotel-SpaClientId'

  AdminClientId:
    Description: Client ID for the server-side admin auth client (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH).
    Value: !Ref AdminUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-AnyCompanyHotel-AdminClientId'

  M2MClientId:
    Description: Client ID for the M2M OAuth2 client_credentials client.
    Value: !Ref M2MUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-AnyCompanyHotel-M2MClientId'

  # The M2M client secret is generated by Cognito and is never written into this
  # template or its outputs. Consumers must retrieve it directly from Cognito, e.g.
  # aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client --user-pool-id <UserPoolId>
  #   --client-id <M2MClientId> --query 'UserPoolClient.ClientSecret' --output text

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the AnyCompany Hotel API resource server used for M2M scopes.
    Value: anycompany-hotel-api
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-AnyCompanyHotel-ResourceServerIdentifier'

  UserPoolDomainName:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain prefix for the AnyCompany Hotel user pool.
    Value: !Ref AnyCompanyHotelUserPoolDomain
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-AnyCompanyHotel-DomainName'

  UserPoolDomainUrl:
    Description: Fully qualified hosted UI / OAuth2 token endpoint base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AnyCompanyHotelUserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-AnyCompanyHotel-DomainUrl'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Hospitality Insights prod Cognito stack - user pool, user pool client, user groups, hosted UI domain, post-authentication Lambda trigger, and an optional OIDC federated identity provider. Fully self-contained; no pre-existing infrastructure is referenced.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    Description: Application name used to build resource names.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the federated identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO integration.
  SsoLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: OIDC issuer URL for the federated identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO integration.

Conditions:
  EnableSso: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoLoginUrl, '']]

Resources:

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: 'custom:last_login'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  PostAuthFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-post-authentication'
      Description: Updates the custom last_login attribute after successful authentication.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthFunctionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: ApplicationName
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              user_name = event["userName"]
              timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

              cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=user_name,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": timestamp}
                  ],
              )

              return event

  PostAuthFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUpdateUserAttributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  PostAuthFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: hours
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - EnableSso
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SsoProviderName
        - - COGNITO
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - custom:last_login
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:last_login

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Administrative users with the highest precedence.
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Standard users.
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Elevated users with additional privileges.
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSso
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        oidc_issuer: !Ref SsoLoginUrl
        authorize_scopes: 'openid email profile'
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito user pool client ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  UserPoolDomain:
    Description: Hosted UI domain prefix.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain

  HostedUiSignInUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI sign-in URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login?client_id=${UserPoolClient}&response_type=code&scope=email+openid+profile'

  PostAuthFunctionArn:
    Description: Post-authentication Lambda function ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn

  AdminGroupName:
    Description: Admin group name.
    Value: !Ref AdminGroup

  RegularUserGroupName:
    Description: RegularUser group name.
    Value: !Ref RegularUserGroup

  PowerUserGroupName:
    Description: PowerUser group name.
    Value: !Ref PowerUserGroup

  SsoProviderName:
    Condition: EnableSso
    Description: Name of the configured federated identity provider.
    Value: !Ref SsoProviderName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cross-region chaos engineering stack. It provisions an AWS Fault Injection
  Simulator (FIS) experiment template that blocks application network traffic
  from this deployment region to a target region and pauses cross-region
  replication for a configurable duration, together with the least-privilege
  FIS execution IAM role, a dedicated customer managed KMS key (plus alias)
  and an encrypted, retained CloudWatch log group used for experiment logging.
  Transit gateways, subnets, S3 buckets and DynamoDB global tables are
  pre-existing resources that FIS selects at run time by tag; this stack never
  creates them.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid AWS Region code such as us-west-2 or eu-central-1.
    Description: >-
      The remote AWS Region whose connectivity to the local deployment Region
      is blocked by the chaos experiment.

  DurationMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 240
    Description: >-
      Number of minutes the network disruption and the replication pauses stay
      in place. Defaults to 20 minutes.

  ChaosTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ChaosAllowed
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: >-
      Tag key used by the experiment targets to select resources that are
      eligible for chaos injection. NOTE: CloudFormation intrinsic functions
      cannot be used as map keys, so this value is rendered into the
      experiment template description while the FIS resource-tag target filter
      uses the literal key 'ChaosAllowed'. Change both together if a different
      tag key is required.

  ChaosTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: >-
      Tag value used by the experiment targets to select resources that are
      eligible for chaos injection.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key dedicated to encrypting FIS experiment logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key used to encrypt AWS FIS experiment logs for ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-logs-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullControl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryptionOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: fis-chaos-engineering
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  FisLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-fis-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisLogsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encrypted, retained CloudWatch log group for FIS experiment logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: fis-chaos-engineering
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution role assumed by the AWS FIS service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-experiment-role'
      Description: >-
        Execution role assumed by AWS Fault Injection Simulator to disrupt
        transit gateway/subnet connectivity and to pause S3 and DynamoDB
        global table replication during a chaos experiment.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFisServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisNetworkAndReplicationDisruption
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DiscoverTaggedNetworkingTargets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DisruptTransitGatewayAndSubnetConnectivity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:route-table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway-route-table/*'
              - Sid: ResolveS3BucketTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                Resource: '*'
              # Scoped to S3 buckets via the resource ARN. A tag-based
              # condition (aws:ResourceTag/...) is intentionally not attached
              # here: condition map keys must be literal strings and the
              # replication-configuration actions do not reliably evaluate the
              # bucket tag condition key, so the bucket-ARN scope is the
              # binding control.
              - Sid: PauseReplicationOnTaggedS3Buckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Sid: ResolveDynamoDBGlobalTableTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:ListTables
                  - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PauseReplicationOnTaggedGlobalTables
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTableSettings
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:global-table/*'
              - Sid: WriteFisExperimentLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FisLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FisLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: fis-chaos-engineering
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Core deliverable: the AWS FIS experiment template
  #
  # CloudFormation does not permit intrinsic functions as map keys, therefore
  # the ResourceTags filter keys below are literal tag-key strings. They
  # default to the ChaosTagKey parameter value ("ChaosAllowed"); change them in
  # lock-step with the ChaosTagKey parameter default if a different tag key is
  # required.
  #
  # VERIFY BEFORE PRODUCTION USE: the action identifiers
  #   aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
  #   aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication
  #   aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
  # and each action's parameter names ("duration" in ISO-8601 form) and target
  # key names must be confirmed against the current AWS FIS actions reference
  # for the deployment Region before an experiment is started.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub >-
        Blocks application network traffic from ${AWS::Region} to ${TargetRegion}
        and pauses cross-region replication for ${DurationMinutes} minutes on
        every target tagged ${ChaosTagKey}=${ChaosTagValue}.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisLogGroup.Arn
      Targets:
        TransitGateways:
          ResourceType: 'aws:ec2:transit-gateway'
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: 'aws:ec2:subnet'
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
        Buckets:
          ResourceType: 'aws:s3:bucket'
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
        Tables:
          ResourceType: 'aws:dynamodb:global-table'
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosTagValue
      Actions:
        DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity:
          ActionId: 'aws:network:disrupt-connectivity'
          Description: !Sub >-
            Disrupts transit gateway connectivity from ${AWS::Region} to
            ${TargetRegion} for ${DurationMinutes} minutes.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${DurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: TransitGateways
        DisruptSubnetConnectivity:
          ActionId: 'aws:network:disrupt-connectivity'
          Description: !Sub >-
            Disrupts subnet connectivity from ${AWS::Region} to ${TargetRegion}
            for ${DurationMinutes} minutes.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${DurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            Subnets: Subnets
        PauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: 'aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication'
          Description: >-
            Pauses S3 cross-region replication on the tagged buckets.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${DurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            Buckets: Buckets
        PauseDynamoDBGlobalTableReplication:
          ActionId: 'aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication'
          Description: >-
            Pauses DynamoDB global table cross-region replication on the
            tagged global tables.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${DurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            Tables: Tables
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-experiment'
        Project: fis-chaos-engineering
        Environment: production

Outputs:
  FisExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: >-
      ID of the AWS FIS experiment template, use it with fis start-experiment.
    Value: !Ref FisExperimentTemplate

  FisExperimentRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the FIS experiment.
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn

  FisLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts FIS logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FisLogsKey.Arn

  FisLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group that receives FIS experiment logs.
    Value: !Ref FisLogGroup
