final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cross-region failover application health monitoring. Creates the Remittance API
  Gateway API, the GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda functions, the
  dbcluster1-instance1 Aurora (RDS) instance, and the CloudWatch metric alarms plus
  the "API Gateway Health", "Lambda Health" and "RDS Health" composite alarms that
  aggregate them with OR logic.

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # Networking (created in-template; no pre-existing infrastructure is used)
  ##############################################################################
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-remittance-vpc'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-remittance-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-remittance-subnet-2'

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Access to the dbcluster1 Aurora cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Aurora MySQL access from inside the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dbcluster1-sg'

  ##############################################################################
  # Customer-managed KMS key for Aurora storage encryption
  ##############################################################################
  DBClusterKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for dbcluster1 Aurora storage encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowRdsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  ##############################################################################
  # Database credentials (generated; never a plaintext password)
  ##############################################################################
  DBClusterCredentials:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/dbcluster1/master-credentials'
      Description: Master user credentials managed for the dbcluster1 Aurora cluster
      KmsKeyId: !Ref DBClusterKmsKey
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"dbadmin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32

  ##############################################################################
  # Aurora (RDS) cluster and the dbcluster1-instance1 instance
  ##############################################################################
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for the dbcluster1 Aurora cluster
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dbcluster1-subnet-group

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: dbcluster1
      Engine: aurora-mysql
      DatabaseName: remittances
      MasterUsername: dbadmin
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref DBClusterKmsKey
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dbcluster1

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: dbcluster1-instance1
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      Engine: aurora-mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1

  ##############################################################################
  # Lambda execution role
  ##############################################################################
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-remittance-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the GetRemittances and CreateRemittance functions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  ##############################################################################
  # Lambda functions
  ##############################################################################
  GetRemittancesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: GetRemittances
      Description: Retrieves remittances for the Remittance API
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"remittances": []})
              }

  CreateRemittanceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: CreateRemittance
      Description: Creates a remittance for the Remittance API
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 201,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"status": "created"})
              }

  ##############################################################################
  # API Gateway: Remittance API
  ##############################################################################
  RemittanceApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-remittance-api'
      Description: Remittance API for the cross-region failover application
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  RemittancesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RemittanceApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: remittances

  GetRemittancesMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi
      ResourceId: !Ref RemittancesResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${GetRemittancesFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  CreateRemittanceMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi
      ResourceId: !Ref RemittancesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateRemittanceFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  GetRemittancesInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref GetRemittancesFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RemittanceApi}/*/GET/remittances'

  CreateRemittanceInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RemittanceApi}/*/POST/remittances'

  RemittanceApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetRemittancesMethod
      - CreateRemittanceMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi
      Description: Deployment of the Remittance API methods

  RemittanceApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref RemittanceApiDeployment
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage for the Remittance API

  ##############################################################################
  # API Gateway metric alarms
  ##############################################################################
  APIGateway4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${RemittanceApi}-4XXError-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: Remittance API 4XX errors (average) greater than 0 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'notBreaching'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApi
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiStage

  APIGateway5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${RemittanceApi}-5XXError-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: Remittance API 5XX errors (average) greater than 1 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'notBreaching'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApi
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiStage

  APIGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${RemittanceApi}-Latency-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: Remittance API latency (average) at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'notBreaching'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApi
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiStage

  ##############################################################################
  # Lambda metric alarms (GetRemittances)
  ##############################################################################
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${GetRemittancesFunction}-Errors-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances summed errors greater than 0 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'notBreaching'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunction

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${GetRemittancesFunction}-Invocations-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances summed invocations greater than 2 over 60 seconds (visibility only; not part of the Lambda Health composite)
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'notBreaching'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunction

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${GetRemittancesFunction}-Duration-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances average duration at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'missing'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunction

  ##############################################################################
  # Lambda metric alarms (CreateRemittance)
  ##############################################################################
  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${CreateRemittanceFunction}-Errors-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance summed errors greater than 0 over 60 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'notBreaching'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunction

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${CreateRemittanceFunction}-Invocations-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance summed invocations greater than 2 over 60 seconds (visibility only; not part of the Lambda Health composite)
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'notBreaching'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunction

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${CreateRemittanceFunction}-Duration-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance average duration at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: 'missing'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunction

  ##############################################################################
  # RDS metric alarms (TreatMissingData intentionally left unset)
  ##############################################################################
  RDSInstanceCPUUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-CPUUtilization-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average CPU utilization at or above 70 percent over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  RDSInstanceDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-DatabaseConnections-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average database connections at or above 100 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  RDSInstanceDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-Deadlocks-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average deadlocks at or above 10 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  RDSInstanceNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-NetworkTransmitThroughput-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average network transmit throughput at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  RDSInstanceNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-NetworkReceiveThroughput-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average network receive throughput at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  RDSInstanceQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-Queries-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average queries at or above 100 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  RDSInstanceDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-DiskQueueDepth-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average disk queue depth at or above 50 over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  RDSInstanceReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-ReadLatency-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average read latency at or above 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  RDSInstanceWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${DBInstance}-WriteLatency-Alarm'
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average write latency at or above 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstance

  ##############################################################################
  # Composite alarms (OR logic across the underlying metric alarms)
  ##############################################################################
  APIGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: Remittance API Gateway health - trips when any API Gateway metric alarm is in ALARM
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM(${APIGateway4XXErrorAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${APIGateway5XXErrorAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${APIGatewayLatencyAlarm})

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: Remittance Lambda health - trips when any Lambda errors or duration alarm is in ALARM
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM(${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm})

  RDSHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health - trips when any RDS metric alarm is in ALARM
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceCPUUtilizationAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceDatabaseConnectionsAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceDeadlocksAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceQueriesAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceDiskQueueDepthAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceReadLatencyAlarm}) OR
        ALARM(${RDSInstanceWriteLatencyAlarm})

Outputs:
  APIGatewayHealthAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the API Gateway Health composite alarm
    Value: !Ref APIGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm

  APIGatewayHealthAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway Health composite alarm
    Value: !GetAtt APIGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn

  LambdaHealthAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda Health composite alarm
    Value: !Ref LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm

  LambdaHealthAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn

  RDSHealthAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the RDS Health composite alarm

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight admin-suite monitoring and data-extraction pipeline (greenfield). Creates a
  retained, private, encrypted S3 output bucket named admin-suite-<accountId>, a private S3
  scripts bucket that hosts the Glue job scripts, 7 AWS Glue jobs (5 Python Shell jobs on
  Glue 3.0 / Python 3.9 and 2 Spark ETL jobs on Glue 5.0 with 2 G.1X workers and 0 retries),
  7 scheduled Glue triggers running every 3 hours, 5 CloudWatch metric streams (JSON output)
  filtering AWS/QuickSight metric groups, 5 DirectPut Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams
  that land each metric group under its own S3 prefix, a customer managed KMS key encrypting
  both buckets, and 1 shared IAM role assumable by glue, cloudformation, firehose and
  streams.metrics.cloudwatch services. Fully self-contained greenfield stack: no external
  dependencies, no deployment-time human input.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: this stack is fully self-contained for a greenfield account.
# Everything it depends on (both S3 buckets, the customer managed KMS key,
# the shared IAM role, all Glue jobs, all Glue triggers, all Firehose delivery
# streams and all CloudWatch metric streams) is created inside this same
# template. Nothing is imported (no Fn::ImportValue), nothing is resolved from
# SSM / Secrets Manager (no {{resolve:...}}), and no account IDs, region names,
# VPC/subnet/SG IDs, AMI IDs or KMS key IDs are hardcoded - only pseudo
# parameters and !GetAtt on in-template resources are used. The Glue script
# bodies (.py) cannot be authored by CloudFormation and must be deployed to
# the ScriptsBucket/scripts/ prefix referenced by each job's ScriptLocation,
# before the first scheduled run of each trigger.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Resources:

  # =========================================================================
  # Customer managed KMS key (SSE-KMS) protecting both S3 buckets.
  # Account root retains full administrative control (prevents key lock-out)
  # and the shared pipeline role is granted usage rights. Retained so that the
  # data in the retained buckets stays readable after stack teardown/update.
  # =========================================================================
  AdminSuiteKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the QuickSight admin-suite monitoring and extraction pipeline S3 buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdministrationAndIamPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSharedPipelineRoleUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  AdminSuiteKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/admin-suite-quicksight
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey

  # =========================================================================
  # Output S3 bucket - holds all QuickSight extracts written by Firehose.
  # Private, SSE-KMS encrypted, TLS-only, retained.
  # =========================================================================
  AdminSuiteOutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  # TLS-only + no-anonymous-access bucket policy for the output bucket.
  AdminSuiteOutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteOutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalType: Anonymous
          - Sid: DenyPublicObjectAcls
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:PutObjectAcl
            Resource: !Sub '${AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl:
                  - public-read
                  - public-read-write
                  - authenticated-read

  # =========================================================================
  # S3 bucket that hosts the Glue job scripts (created in-template so that no
  # pre-existing "predefined script bucket" is assumed). SSE-KMS encrypted.
  # =========================================================================
  AdminSuiteScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AdminSuiteScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  # =========================================================================
  # Single shared IAM role.
  # Trusted by glue, cloudformation, firehose and streams.metrics.cloudwatch.
  # Grants QuickSight read/describe/list, Glue, S3, KMS (CMK usage),
  # CloudWatch (metrics + logs), Firehose and narrowly scoped IAM permissions.
  # No secrets are embedded.
  # =========================================================================
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Description: Shared role for the QuickSight admin-suite monitoring and extraction pipeline.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceAssumption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteQuickSightReadAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightListDescribeGet
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteGlueAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueJobTriggerCatalog
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                  - glue:StartTrigger
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
                  - glue:GetCatalogImportStatus
                  - glue:CreateDatabase
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadGlueScripts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteScriptsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: ReadWriteOutputData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UsePipelineCmkOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                  - kms:ReEncryptTo
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteCloudWatchAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: GlueJobLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteFirehoseAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: FirehoseDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteIamAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassAndGetSharedRoleOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}'

  # =========================================================================
  # Glue Python Shell jobs (Glue 3.0 / Python 3.9).
  # No WorkerType / NumberOfWorkers - invalid for pythonshell jobs.
  # MaxConcurrentRuns = 1, Timeout = 120 minutes.
  # =========================================================================

  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Periodically collects QuickSight asset access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Periodically collects QuickSight asset metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Periodically collects QuickSight folder structure information.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Periodically collects QuickSight Q topic metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'

  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Periodically collects QuickSight Q object access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'

  # =========================================================================
  # Glue Spark ETL jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X, 2 workers, MaxRetries 0).
  # MaxConcurrentRuns = 1, Timeout = 120 minutes.
  # =========================================================================

  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Periodically extracts QuickSight dataset properties.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Periodically extracts QuickSight data source properties.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'

  # =========================================================================
  # Seven scheduled Glue triggers - one dedicated trigger per job,
  # cron(0 */3 * * ? *) - every 3 hours, started immediately on creation.
  # =========================================================================

  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  TriggerQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_q_access every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQAccess

  TriggerDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDsProperties

  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  # =========================================================================
  # Five DirectPut Firehose delivery streams - each writes one QuickSight
  # metric group into its own prefix of the retained, SSE-KMS output bucket.
  # =========================================================================

  DeliveryStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-ingestion
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/ingestion/'
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5

  DeliveryStreamVisualLoad:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-visual-load
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/visual-load/'
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5

  DeliveryStreamSpiceCapacity:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-spice-capacity
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/spice-capacity/'
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5

  DeliveryStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-quick-index
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/quick-index/'
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5

  DeliveryStreamActionInvocation:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-action-invocation
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteOutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/action-invocation/'
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5

  # =========================================================================
  # Five CloudWatch metric streams (JSON output) - each filters one set of
  # AWS/QuickSight metrics and feeds its dedicated Firehose stream.
  # =========================================================================

  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quicksight-ingestion-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DeliveryStreamIngestion.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount

  MetricStreamVisualLoad:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quicksight-visual-load-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DeliveryStreamVisualLoad.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  MetricStreamSpiceCapacity:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quicksight-spice-capacity-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DeliveryStreamSpiceCapacity.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityLimitInMB
            - SPICECapacityConsumedInMB

  MetricStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quicksight-quick-index-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DeliveryStreamQuickIndex.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QuickIndexDocumentCount
            - QuickIndexExtractedTextSize

  MetricStreamActionInvocation:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quicksight-action-invocation-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DeliveryStreamActionInvocation.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - ActionInvocationError
            - ActionInvocationCount

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM roles, instance profiles, and customer managed policies required by the
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap process for an Amazon EKS cluster.

Parameters:
  ClusterNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: capa
    Description: >-
      Prefix applied to the names of every IAM role, instance profile, and
      customer managed policy created by this template.

Resources:

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane-role"
      Description: IAM role for Kubernetes control plane nodes managed by CAPA
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-nodes-role"
      Description: IAM role for Kubernetes worker nodes managed by CAPA
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers-role"
      Description: IAM role for the CAPA controllers, assumable by EC2 instances and EKS pods
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  EksControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-eks-control-plane-role"
      Description: IAM role assumed by the Amazon EKS control plane service
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-nodes-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  ControlPlaneLegacyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane-legacy-policy"
      Description: Legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider permissions for Kubernetes control plane nodes
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Describe
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: EC2SecurityGroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/*"
          - Sid: EC2TagManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: EC2VolumeAndInstanceManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:volume/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*"
          - Sid: AutoScalingManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingDescribe
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerListenerSSLCertificate
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:loadbalancer/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:targetgroup/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:listener/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:listener-rule/*"
          - Sid: KMSManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: "*"

  NodeRegistrationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-node-registration-policy"
      Description: Permissions that allow cluster nodes to register with the cluster and pull container images
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2NodeDescribe
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ECRRepositoryPull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*"
          - Sid: ECRAuthorizationToken
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: SecretsManagerRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*"
          - Sid: SSMParameterRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeParameters
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: "*"

  CapaControllerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ClusterNamePrefix}-capa-controller-policy"
      Description: Permissions used by the Cluster API Provider AWS controllers to manage cluster infrastructure
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Describe
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates an AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job and its supporting IAM service role for
  converting Shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files. Also provisions the S3
  buckets referenced by the job for raw GIS input, Glue scripts/artifacts, and
  knowledge-base output, plus a customer managed KMS key used to encrypt them.

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue ETL job.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'

  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    Description: S3 location (URI) of the Glue ETL Python script.
    AllowedPattern: '^s3://.+$'

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    Description: Name of the IAM service role used by the Glue ETL job.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]+$'

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the Glue data buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueDataKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key encrypting the Glue Shapefile-to-GeoJSON data buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowGlueServiceRoleUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${GlueServiceRoleName}'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  GlueDataKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/map-appraiser-glue-data
      TargetKeyId: !Ref GlueDataKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Buckets (greenfield - created because they do not pre-exist)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RawGisDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-data-raw-gis
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt GlueDataKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  GlueScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-glue-scripts
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt GlueDataKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  KnowledgeBaseDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt GlueDataKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Bucket Policies (explicit TLS-only enforcement, no AccessControl used)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RawGisDataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RawGisDataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RawGisDataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${RawGisDataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GlueScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref GlueScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  KnowledgeBaseDataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref KnowledgeBaseDataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseDataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${KnowledgeBaseDataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Service Role for AWS Glue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: Service role assumed by the AWS Glue Shapefile-to-GeoJSON ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGlueAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:GetLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricData'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: GlueS3ReadOnlyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ReadOnlyForRawGisAndScripts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawGisDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${RawGisDataBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: GlueS3ReadWriteAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ReadWriteForKnowledgeBase
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${KnowledgeBaseDataBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: GlueKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KmsAccessForEncryptedBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt GlueDataKmsKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL Job
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GlueJobName
      Description: Converts Shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Ref GlueScriptLocation
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-spark-ui': 'true'
        '--spark-event-logs-path': !Sub 's3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/spark-logs/'
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-enable'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/temp/'
        '--additional-python-modules': 'geopandas0.14.1,shapely2.0.2,pyproj3.6.1,fiona1.9.5'

Outputs:

  GlueJobName:
    Description: Name of the created AWS Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueJobName'

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role used by the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueServiceRoleArn'

  S3ScriptUploadCommand:
    Description: AWS CLI command to upload the Glue ETL script to the scripts bucket.
    Value: !Sub 'aws s3 cp shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py s3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-S3ScriptUploadCommand'

          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationServiceToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccountLevelS3BlockPublicAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AccountPublicAccessBlock
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'

  AccountS3BlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-account-block-public-access'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content: !Sub |
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Enables S3 Block Public Access at the account level.'
        assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: 'The ARN of the IAM role assumed by the Automation execution.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '${AWS::AccountId}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
          - name: GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: GetPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '${AWS::AccountId}'

  EventBridgeStartAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eventbridge-start-ssm-automation'
      Description: >-
        Execution role used by the EventBridge scheduled rule to start the
        account-level S3 Block Public Access SSM Automation document.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartS3AccountBlockPublicAccessAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAutomationExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${AccountS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}'
              - Sid: PassAutomationAssumeRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SsmS3AccountBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole.Arn

  DailyAccountS3BlockPublicAccessRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-block-public-access-daily'
      Description: >-
        Runs the account-level S3 Block Public Access Automation document once
        every day.
      State: ENABLED
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(1 day)'
      Targets:
        - Id: AccountS3BlockPublicAccessAutomationTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${AccountS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeStartAutomationRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub '{"AutomationAssumeRole":["${SsmS3AccountBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole.Arn}"]}'

Outputs:

  AutomationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document that enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access.
    Value: !Ref AccountS3BlockPublicAccessDocument

  AutomationDocumentArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM Automation document that enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${AccountS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}'

  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the SSM Automation document.
    Value: !GetAtt SsmS3AccountBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole.Arn

  EventBridgeRuleName:
    Description: Name of the enabled EventBridge scheduled rule that runs the automation daily.
    Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-block-public-access-daily'

  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the enabled EventBridge scheduled rule that runs the automation daily.
    Value: !GetAtt DailyAccountS3BlockPublicAccessRule.Arn
